stories.summary: Owner-only selection of the project's single LLM-scan AI model profile and high/medium/low tier on the project settings page, refusing non-owners, profiles from another project, non-AI-model integrations and unknown tiers, and allowing the owner to clear the setting

Author starts a full static-then-LLM security check from the build page and reads the LLM report's model, advisory banner and findings with severity, rule, file and line; the LLM stage runs only after a static pass, uses the project's configured profile and tier, refuses per-scan model overrides and non-members, and a critical finding never blocks starting or finishing a run

Author runs a full check on untrusted skill content and the LLM sandbox holds only the model key, reaches only the model endpoint and reads the exact bundle the static scan passed, so no project credential or other service is exposed while the report still renders the located finding

Author sees an explicit unavailable or failed LLM scan with its exact reason on the report page — no model profile, missing key, rejected key, budget exhaustion, scanner exiting without a report or the ten-minute timeout — and an unavailable or failed scan never blocks starting or finishing a run
